visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three people, two females and one male, walk down a narrow city street in late afternoon light. The female on the left wears a red Kodak cap and a black leather jacket, smiling and talking animatedly. The female on the right wears a light grey coat, listening and laughing. (2) The scene cuts to an exterior shot of a modern, multi-story building at dusk. A sign reads 'PONO BUONO' with text indicating 'Hidden Genius' chef. An outdoor staircase leads to the restaurant entrance. (3) Inside, the lighting is warm and dim. A close-up shows hands pulling a slice of freshly baked bread, revealing thick, stretching melted cheese. Plates of appetizers are visible in the background on the wooden table. (4) A woman in a yellow hoodie is shown in a medium close-up, tasting the food with a surprised and delighted facial expression. (5) A young man with short hair and a black Kodak t-shirt eats a piece of bread, gesturing with his hand as he speaks to the camera about the texture. (6) The camera zooms in on a plate containing grilled calamari rings, sautéed mushrooms, and a bright yellow raw egg yolk in the center. (7) The male character uses a fork to pick up a mushroom, pointing at its texture while talking. (8) A plate of thick, crispy-skinned pork belly slices served with green sauce and onion garnishes is shown in a sharp close-up. (9) The man tastes the pork, nodding slightly with a concentrated expression as he evaluates the fat content. (10) A steaming plate of spaghetti-style pasta, garnished with fresh herbs and grated cheese, is stirred with tongs, releasing steam under the warm restaurant lights. (11) The two women and the man are shown in separate cuts tasting the pasta, with the woman in the white coat holding a fork and speaking directly about the garlic flavor. (12) The video ends with a close-up of the woman in the red cap from the start, giving a thumbs-up and smiling broadly towards the camera.
